_avail.notes: Weight changed 1.6 kg -> 1.62 kg per UA844+ guide p.7.; Variant "Antenna/Power Distribution System" → "174-216 MHz" (from the part number; the intake form gave one Variant to several part numbers); powerDrawW 30.5 W computed from the UA844+ user guide (shure/UA844SWBplus-user-guide.pdf, DC In: 15 V DC, 2.54 A): 15 × 2.54 = 38.1 VA × 0.8 (AVAIL utilisation factor), as accepted by proposal bda48968; includes up to 2.5 A passed to receivers via DC Out 1-4. Computed: V × A × 0.8
_avail.portsMissing: The guide does not state the number of RF outputs per channel in text (5 per channel assumed from 'up to five receivers' and the 10 supplied BNC cables); the front-panel Antenna A/B connectors (front-mount antenna hardware) are not modelled separately. Number of RF output jacks per antenna channel is not stated in the UA844+ user guide (panel drawing not in the PDF): RF Out A / RF Out B are modelled once each; verify against the rear panel.
